caption: The drawing depicts a wooden writing desk with both upper and lower components. The desk is shown in three-quarter view, with six visible fluted legs and a rectangular composition. The upper section consists of four rectangular cabinet doors, each with a small round knob and a patterned wood grain design. The cabinets are set atop short columns that extend to the desktop. The lower section of the desk features three drawers with round knobs aligned horizontally, and the desktop itself has two green, felt-like writing surfaces. One writing surface is flat, while the other is slanted and bordered by a wooden frame. The wood throughout is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain detail, and the drawing is set against a plain, off-white background.
title: Desk
